PLAN "12-Week Pregnancy Strength Program for Advanced Lifter"

TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and safe progression through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation &Safety A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & Safety B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          sumo_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2 minutes
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & Safety C":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seal_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pipe_cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & Safety D":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up (assisted if needed) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          front_squat (or goblet_squat if needing reduced load) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
          hip_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          sumo_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2 minutes
          lower_back_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression C":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
          glute_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression D":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Peak Maintenance A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up assisted 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          front_squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          upper_body_stretches 4 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Peak Maintenance B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
          lower_back_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Deload & Safety":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full-body stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Return to Stability & Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up assisted 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility circuit 5 minutes

ADDITIONAL NOTES:
- Exercise choices avoid supine positions after week 16; where a press or row could be supported supine, substitute with seated or standing variations (e.g., seated_row, incline_press instead of flat bench if needed).
- RPE targets are moderate; adjust load to keep breathing conversation and to avoid Valsalva with breath-holding.
- Maintain hydration and electrolyte balance; monitor for warning signs (dizziness, shortness of breath, joint pain, dizziness).
- If fatigue or any warning signs arise, switch to lighter loads or drop to maintenance sets (e.g., 2x8..12) for that session.
- No max attempts; avoid contact sports; avoid lying flat on back after second trimester; use variable incline or seated variations to minimize supine time.
- Cardio: warmups/cooldowns use walking or light cycling as tolerated; avoid high-impact or risky steps if unstable.
- Progression: weekly intent is gradual load maintenance or small increases in reps/loads while staying within RPE targets.
